record.reason: This controlled study compares LLM inference, quantization and deployment platform across Jetson Orin, server GPU and server CPU, measuring accuracy, latency, model footprint and energy. It uses Pareto analysis to help select local-versus-remote execution, but does not introduce a new inference optimization or serving system; it is an empirical deployment-selection study, making the fit borderline.
record.title: A Measurement Study of LLM Inference Trade-offs Across Edge Continuum Hardware
